prompt: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
response_text:
Subject: No Class This Week – Introduction to Computer Science

Dear Students,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to let you know that our Introduction to Computer Science class will **not** be meeting this week. This applies to all scheduled sessions, including lectures and any associated lab or discussion sections.

Please use this time to review the course materials we have covered so far, work on any outstanding assignments, and prepare for upcoming topics. Any assignments that are currently due will remain on schedule unless you hear otherwise from the professor.

If you have any questions or concerns in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out to me via email or during my regular office hours.

We will resume our normal schedule next week. Stay tuned for any further announcements.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Teaching Assistant – Introduction to Computer Science
[Your Email Address]
[Office Hours & Location]
